description: Continents, countries, landforms, and geographic facts about Earth

asia.notable: Highest point (Everest), largest plateau (Tibetan), largest lake (Caspian Sea)

africa.notable: Most countries, oldest human fossils, longest river (Nile)

north_america.notable: Great Plains, Rocky Mountains, Mississippi River, Great Lakes

south_america.notable: Amazon River (largest by volume), Andes (longest mountain range), Amazon Rainforest

antarctica.notable: Contains 70% of Earth's fresh water; average thickness of ice 2.2 km

europe.notable: Most interconnected continent; EU; Rhine, Danube rivers

australia_oceania.notable: Smallest continent; Great Barrier Reef; unique wildlife

world_records.largest_desert: Antarctic Desert (14 million km²); Sahara is largest hot desert (9.2 million km²)

political_geography.most_borders: China and Russia (each share borders with 14 countries)
political_geography.landlocked_countries: 44 countries with no direct ocean access
political_geography.island_nations: Notable: Japan, UK, Australia, Indonesia, Philippines

major_mountain_ranges.andes: South America; 7,000 km long; longest continental range
major_mountain_ranges.rockies: North America; 4,800 km; divide Pacific/Atlantic drainage
major_mountain_ranges.alps: Europe; 1,200 km; Mont Blanc highest at 4,808 m

biomes.tropical_rainforest: Near equator; high rainfall; Amazon, Congo, SE Asia
biomes.savanna: Tropical grassland with dry season; sub-Saharan Africa
biomes.desert: Less than 250mm rain/year; hot or cold
biomes.temperate_forest: Deciduous trees; four seasons; Europe, E. North America
biomes.taiga_boreal: Coniferous forest; northern Canada, Russia, Scandinavia
biomes.grassland: Prairies (N. America), Pampas (S. America), Steppes (Central Asia)
